changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientallergies AS SELECT pa.id, pa.patient_id, pa.encounter_id, pa.allergen_type, pa.allergen_id, pa.severity, pa.medication_class_id, pa.criticality, pa.certainty, pa.treatment_strategy, pa.onset, pa.onset_date_undefined, pa.onset_date, pa.type_of_propensity, pa.by_patient, pa.source_of_information, pa.allergic_reactions, pa.note, pa.status, pa.resolved_by, pa.resolved_date, pa.cancelled_by, pa.cancelled_date, pa.cancellation_reason, pa.created_by, pa.created_date, pa.last_modified_by, pa.last_modified_date, pa.allergen_name FROM public.patient_allergies pa;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientallergies TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientallergies FROM report_user;
